label: PRECOMPUTED
solver: STRATO BTCS five-layer spherical finite difference
note: Requests of the small cases of the parity battery of the BTCS functions (validate, run, export, build info) and the replies of the native wrapper (x86_64), the reference of the browser parity test of the functions beyond the default run.

validate_toml.input:
# SYNTHETIC NUMERICAL BENCHMARK - NOT LITERATURE TRISO DATA
case_name = "synthetic-five-layer-release"
species = "synthetic"
temperature_k = 1000.0

[[regions]]
name = "Kernel"
outer_radius_m = 2.0e-4
diffusivity_m2_s = 1.0e-12
cells = 40

[[regions]]
name = "Buffer"
outer_radius_m = 3.0e-4
diffusivity_m2_s = 4.0e-10
cells = 40

[[regions]]
name = "IPyC"
outer_radius_m = 3.5e-4
diffusivity_m2_s = 8.0e-13
cells = 40

[[regions]]
name = "SiC"
outer_radius_m = 4.0e-4
diffusivity_m2_s = 2.0e-14
cells = 40

[[regions]]
name = "OPyC"
outer_radius_m = 4.5e-4
diffusivity_m2_s = 7.0e-13
cells = 40

[initial]
kernel_concentration_mol_m3 = 1.0

[time]
dt_s = 2.0e2
end_time_s = 2.0e5
output_every_steps = 10

[output]
directory = "results/synthetic-five-layer"

solver.label: COMPUTED v2.0
solver.nature: numerical solution of the stated model; not experimental validation
solver.scope: constant diffusivity in each layer, no source, no decay, constant temperature (recorded, not used), kernel-only start, absorbing outer surface

analytical.assumptions: constant diffusivity per layer, no source, no decay, constant temperature, kernel-only start, absorbing outer surface
analytical.name: analytical (Sturm-Liouville series)

balance.generated_and_decayed_note: the solved model has no source and no decay, so both terms are exactly zero by construction; they are not measured
balance.statement: remaining + released + decayed - start - generated = residual (equation F30); the directive writes the same identity with the opposite sign of the residual

tolerance.kind: a-posteriori rounding bound (coordinator decision 6); not a discretisation error
